title: Cavity Control of Strongly Correlated Electrons Beyond Resonant Coupling
summary: Interfacing materials with electromagnetic cavities offers a route to modify equilibrium properties through structured vacuum fluctuations. The coupling between light and correlated electrons lacks a characteristic energy scale, making vacuum induced ground state modifications of such systems inherently off-resonant and sensitive to the full photon mode structure. We develop a consistent cavity-QED formalism for dispersive electromagnetic environments in the Coulomb gauge, capturing both dynamical dressing via the vector potential and static screening by the dielectric.
